name: OpenTelemetry Certified Associate

fee.note: Published exam-only price; includes two exam attempts and 12 months to schedule. A bundle with the THRIVE-ONE annual subscription costs $495.

exam.format: Online, proctored multiple-choice exam: 60 questions in 90 minutes. No prerequisites.

access.retake: One free retake is included if the first attempt is not passed; it must be taken within the 12 months of eligibility that start at purchase, with no enforced wait beyond scoring (up to 24 hours) and the 24-hour booking lead time.
access.accommodations: Candidates with disabilities send the Test Accommodations Form at least two weeks before the exam, before scheduling it; requests are reviewed case by case.

scope: Observability fundamentals, API/SDK, Collector and maintaining/debugging telemetry pipelines. This is an adjacent engineering credential, not an AI exam.
ai_policy: Check the current exam resource rules; preparation includes unaided instrumentation and troubleshooting.
caveats: The 60-question count and 75% pass mark come from the Linux Foundation multiple-choice exam instructions and FAQ linked from the certification page, which cover all its multiple-choice exams except the CNPA.

prep.title: Linux Foundation: Getting Started with OpenTelemetry (LFS148)

domains_note: Weights from the Linux Foundation certification page, 'Domains & Competencies' section, read 2026-11-17; the CNCF OTCA curriculum PDF gives the same weights.
